news.text: 10 September saw NBC broadcast the series premiere of the groundbreaking sitcom ***The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air***. Starring 21-year-old Philadelphia hip-hop star **Will Smith** as a street-smart teenager sent to live with his wealthy relatives in California, the show became an immediate transatlantic hit, celebrated for addressing race, class, and family dynamics with infectious humour and **iconic 1990s fashion**.
news.youtube: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air original 1990 theme song and intro

news.text: 12 September saw the foreign ministers of East Germany, West Germany, France, the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States sign the historic **Two Plus Four Agreement** in Moscow. Officially titled the *Treaty on the Final Settlement with Respect to Germany*, the accord renounced all four-power occupation rights and paved the legal path for full **German reunification** as a sovereign **democratic nation**.

news.text: 15 September saw American rock group The Steve Miller Band soar to number one on the UK Singles Chart with ***The Joker***, sixteen years after its original 1973 release. Powered by Hugh Johnson's wildly stylish **Levi's 501 jeans television commercial** featuring motorcycle-riding star Peter Carey, the resurrected track spent two weeks atop the **British charts**.
news.youtube: Levis 501 The Joker commercial 1990 Steve Miller Band

news.text: 19 September saw Martin Scorsese's biographical crime drama ***Goodfellas*** open in North American cinemas before its international rollout. Starring Ray Liotta, Robert De Niro, and **Joe Pesci**, the visceral adaptation of Nicholas Pileggi's *Wiseguy* was hailed as an instant cinematic masterpiece for its kinetic camera movements, freeze frames, and unvarnished portrait of **American mafia life**.
news.youtube: Goodfellas original theatrical trailer 1990 Martin Scorsese

news.text: 29 September saw the final decorative finial placed on the **Washington National Cathedral**, marking the formal completion of the world's sixth-largest cathedral after **83 years of construction**. Initiated in 1907 with a foundation stone laid by President Theodore Roosevelt, the Neo-Gothic landmark was officially dedicated in the presence of President **George H.W. Bush**.

gaming.title: Wing Commander
gaming.reviewQuote: Wing Commander is a monumental leap forward in PC entertainment. The graphics are simply stunning and the cinematic atmosphere makes you feel like you are genuinely living inside a sci-fi blockbuster.
gaming.headline: Dogfights in the Kilrathi Void, 256 VGA Colours, and Cinematic PC Greatness
gaming.gameplay: Released on 26 September 1990 for MS-DOS computers, *Wing Commander* revolutionised space combat gaming. Designed and directed by **Chris Roberts**, the game cast players as a rookie starfighter pilot aboard the carrier *TCS Tiger's Claw*, battling the predatory feline Kilrathi empire. Roberts pioneered dynamic bitmap sprite scaling to simulate full 3D space dogfights, paired with interactive shipboard cockpit views, wingman tactical radio commands, and a **branching mission tree** where failure in battle redirected the campaign without ending the game.
gaming.reception: Demanding state-of-the-art 386 processors, 256-colour VGA displays, and Sound Blaster audio cards, *Wing Commander* astonished contemporary critics. Publications hailed its living, breathing shipboard environment—where pilots gossiped in the officer's bar and attended military funeral ceremonies for fallen wingmen—as the pinnacle of computer gaming immersion.
gaming.impact: The game sparked a legendary multi-million-selling franchise, accelerated PC hardware upgrades across the world, and established Origin Systems' famous studio motto: 'We Create Worlds'.
